description: Invite people to a meeting by email. They get a standard calendar invitation (Gmail, Outlook, Apple) with Yes / No / Maybe buttons; their answers come back to this inbox (see list_invites). Pass title, start, attendees and either duration_minutes (default 30) or end. Times are ISO 8601 with an offset, or local times plus time_zone. For a video call pass meeting_url; for an all-day event all_day: true with dates. Confirm the date, time, time zone and guests with your operator before sending. Returns invite_id for update_invite / cancel_invite.

all_day.description: true for an all-day event: start/end are dates (YYYY-MM-DD). No time_zone or duration_minutes.

attendees.description: Guest email address(es), e.g. anna@example.com or Anna <anna@example.com>.

credentials_dir.description: Credential directory for this call (default: ATOMIC_MAIL_CREDENTIALS_DIR or ~/.atomicmail). Use separate paths per account; see help topic multi_account.

description.description: Agenda or notes shown in the invitation.

duration_minutes.description: Length in minutes when end is not given (default 30).

end.description: End (same format). Overrides duration_minutes. With all_day: the last day, inclusive (default: start).

location.description: Where: an address or a room. Defaults to meeting_url.

meeting_url.description: Video-call link (https), e.g. Zoom, Meet or Teams. Guests see it as the location and a Join line in the email.

start.description: Start, e.g. 2026-10-16T15:00:00+03:00, or 2026-10-16T15:00 with time_zone, or a date 2026-10-16 with all_day.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone the times are in, e.g. Europe/Moscow. Required when start/end have no UTC offset. Also used to write the date in the email.

name: send_invite
title: Send a meeting invitation
